```python
pick_head = min(best_of[owner[int(other)]] for other in linked)
pick = index of cluster with head == pick_head
```
Since heads are unique, we can build a head→position map. Let me rewrite that part.

Also `if matrix.ndim == 1` in generalised_interval: when count=1, np.asarray([tuple]) gives shape (1,L) ✓ so not needed but harmless.

Let me fix cluster_group.
